provenance.note: user-provided; synthetic fixture, no real product depicted

observations.statement: Vertical stack: top HUD strip (~8% of height), centred hero illustration (~45%), one primary button, then a 4-item bottom tab bar (~10%).
Background is a light pastel pink filling most of the frame; a second lighter cream band sits behind the hero illustration.
observations.evidence: full-bleed background; band behind centre illustration

observations.statement: The single most saturated colour is a warm orange used only on the primary button and the coin counter icon.
observations.evidence: primary button fill (centre-bottom), coin icon in HUD (top-left)

observations.statement: Primary button is a full pill (radius equals half of its height); bottom tab bar container and HUD chips use a large but non-pill radius (~25% of element height).
observations.evidence: primary button corners; tab bar container corners; HUD chip corners

observations.statement: Every interactive element has a visible dark outline, roughly 1.5-2% of the element height, in a darker shade of its own fill colour rather than black.
observations.evidence: primary button, HUD chips, tab bar icons

observations.statement: Buttons show a flat fill with a lighter horizontal highlight band across the top third and a solid darker bottom edge; no gradient within the fill.
observations.evidence: primary button face and bottom edge

observations.statement: Display text is a heavy rounded sans-serif in Title Case; HUD numerals are the same family at a smaller size with a dark outline.
observations.evidence: primary button label 'Play'; HUD coin and level counters

observations.statement: The exact font family name cannot be identified from the raster image.
observations.evidence: n/a — family identification requires the source asset or user confirmation

observations.statement: HUD consists of two chips (coins, lives) left-aligned and a settings gear right-aligned; chips are pill-shaped with the icon overlapping the left edge.
Icons are filled, rounded, two-tone (fill plus darker outline), with no thin-stroke icons anywhere in the frame.
observations.evidence: tab bar icons, HUD coin and heart icons, settings gear

observations.statement: Primary button label (white on orange) is estimated at roughly 3:1 contrast; the dark outline around glyphs likely raises effective legibility, but the ratio against the fill alone would not meet 4.5:1.
observations.evidence: primary button label; estimate from sampled colours #FFFFFF on #FF8A3D

observations.statement: No motion information is available from a single static frame.

rules.statement: Pastel light background with one warm saturated accent reserved for the primary action and reward/currency indicators.
Pill silhouette; darker-shade-of-fill outline; top highlight band plus solid darker bottom edge; label in heavy rounded sans, Title Case.
Two radius classes only: pill for buttons and chips, xl (~25% of height) for containers and panels.
HUD chips are pills with a leading icon overlapping the left edge; currency chips left, settings right.
Filled rounded icons with a darker outline; no outline-only or thin-stroke icon sets.
Heavy rounded sans classification for display and HUD numerals; Title Case for labels. Family name is unknown and must be confirmed by the user.
